operation.body:
## Goal
Prepare a concrete, reviewable R-001 specification for the first read-only discovery CLI, and reconcile bootstrap readiness against merged PR #8 and current main. Deliver one documentation-only PR; proposed design choices remain unapproved until the owner explicitly accepts them.

## Acceptance criteria
- Reverify and record bootstrap evidence: approved definition and stack, merged human bootstrap PR #8, passed current default-branch CI, greenfield command deferrals and remaining operation-specific gates.
- Specify a bounded first implementation slice, source/capability matrix, JSON/JSONL observations and failure semantics, privacy field allowlist, sampling/storage/deadline bounds, and fixture plus owner-device validation criteria. Map AC-01 through AC-06 without claiming full discovery coverage.
- Present concrete R-001 options with a recommendation, distinguishing public-source discovery from a later separately reviewed AppleSMC adapter. Keep exact toolchain/SDK verification and hardware permissions explicit; do not silently adopt a dependency or interface.
- Update directly affected project context to distinguish passed bootstrap from pending R-001 implementation review. Preserve historical data and reusable private workflow.
- Check local links, consistency, whitespace, adapter contracts and leak policy; complete review and remote CI. No product code or hardware commands.

## Constraints
Parent: https://github.com/szymoniwacz/mac-thermal-control/issues/1. Authorized by the owner's current local execute-project self-correcting-review auto-merge invocation; eligible goals may squash merge, while mandatory human-review/security gates remain. Documentation proposals do not change runtime permissions, privacy posture or hardware behavior. One goal only; no background automation. Preserve unrelated .gitlab/ files. Risks: proposal becoming accidental approval, premature compatibility claims, incomplete source coverage, unbounded native calls. Decision queue: R-001 adoption belongs to owner review before affected implementation; this goal only prepares the proposal. Stop if documentation completion itself requires a material decision.

## Out of scope
Product scaffold/code, dependency/toolchain installation, source adoption, native driver transactions, telemetry capture, privilege elevation, workloads, fan/control writes, GUI/controller implementation, scope expansion, a second delegated goal.

## Relevant context
.ai/docs/project-requirements.md (R-001, AC-01–AC-06, readiness); .ai/docs/architecture-direction.md; .ai/project/; docs/monterey-telemetry-research.md; PR #8 (merged a4d3c6ff1f3c398a8bfbcc1657a734d4d4ab90bb); default-branch CI run 43577417652. Prior owner approvals: https://github.com/szymoniwacz/mac-thermal-control/issues/1#issuecomment-6863771976.
